title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Badges that came back on their own
summary: Turning the dependency badges off while the project sweep was running let that sweep paint them again seconds later.

highlights.title: A setting that undid itself
highlights.description: The sweep that counts imports across the project takes seconds. It decided whether to draw before that read instead of after, so badges switched off mid sweep were drawn again when it landed.

highlights.title: Painting through a disposed provider
highlights.description: A sweep landing after the provider was disposed wrote through a decoration type that no longer exists.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The dependency badges stay off once switched off, even when a project sweep was already running.
A sweep that lands after the provider is gone no longer paints.
The release check for banned dashes now reads inside multi line templates, so webview text is covered like every other string.
